critical_missing_information.missing_information: Data sensitivity and presence of personal/sensitive data
critical_missing_information.question_to_ask: Does the AI system process personal, sensitive, customer, employee, or confidential data?
critical_missing_information.why_it_matters: Drives applicability of key data protection, privacy, encryption, and compliance controls.

critical_missing_information.missing_information: Deployment status of the AI system
critical_missing_information.question_to_ask: Is the AI system currently in concept, prototype, pilot, or production?
critical_missing_information.why_it_matters: Determines whether operational, monitoring, resilience, and incident response controls apply.

critical_missing_information.question_to_ask: Are prompts, inputs, outputs, agent actions, and API calls logged and actively monitored?
critical_missing_information.why_it_matters: Directly affects observability, auditability, and detection capabilities for agent behaviour.

critical_missing_information.missing_information: Existence of AI system and supply chain inventory
critical_missing_information.question_to_ask: Is there an inventory of AI systems, data assets, and third-party/vendor components (e.g., models, frameworks, APIs)?
critical_missing_information.why_it_matters: Inventory is foundational for governance, supply chain risk, and asset-level control scoping.

critical_missing_information.missing_information: Model usage pattern (training, fine-tuning, or API consumption)
critical_missing_information.question_to_ask: Is the organization training/fine-tuning models or only consuming external models (e.g., Claude via API)?
critical_missing_information.why_it_matters: Determines applicability of model lifecycle, training pipeline, and data integrity controls.

critical_missing_information.missing_information: User-facing exposure of the AI system
critical_missing_information.question_to_ask: Is the AI system internal-facing, employee-facing, or exposed to customers/public users?
critical_missing_information.why_it_matters: Impacts risk level, abuse scenarios, monitoring scope, and acceptable use policies.

non_critical_missing_information.missing_information: Level of agent autonomy and human oversight
non_critical_missing_information.question_to_ask: Do agents operate autonomously or require human approval for high-impact actions?
non_critical_missing_information.why_it_matters: Impacts applicability of human-in-the-loop and authorization controls.

non_critical_missing_information.question_to_ask: What types of tools, plugins, or APIs can the agents invoke (internal systems, external SaaS, databases, etc.)?
non_critical_missing_information.why_it_matters: Improves threat modelling accuracy and agent boundary security decisions.

non_critical_missing_information.question_to_ask: Where is the AI system hosted (cloud provider, on-premises, hybrid)?
non_critical_missing_information.why_it_matters: Affects infrastructure, network, and shared responsibility scoping.
